obligations.where: go/internal/issue/build.go — delivery gate: `unexpectedCommitted := unexpectedPaths(filesChanged, allowedPaths)` and `dirtyPaths := worktreeStatusPaths(worktreePath)`; `if len(unexpectedCommitted) > 0 || len(dirtyPaths) > 0 { deliveryError = "GIT_DELIVERY: ..." }`, which forces `success = codingOK && len(commits) > 0 && verifyOK && deliveryError == ""`

obligations.where: go/internal/harnessx/schema.go — startStructuredOutputCapture: `pattern := filepath.Join(projectDir, ".agentfield-out-*")`, reading `filepath.Join(newDirs[0], ".agentfield_output.json")`, failing closed when more than one new dir appears; called with `opts.ProjectDir` in executeStructured
